description: Defines functions, constants, and utilities for seed material generation and manipulation within the Abseil random internal namespace, including seed entropy calculations, seed filling from OS entropy or URBG, seed mixing, and salt retrieval.

methods.name: SeedBitsToBlocks
methods.description: Calculates the number of 32-bit blocks needed to contain a given number of bits.

methods.name: ReadSeedMaterialFromOSEntropy
methods.description: Fills a span of uint32_t with seed material obtained from OS entropy source.

methods.name: ReadSeedMaterialFromURBG
methods.description: Fills a span of uint32_t with seed material generated from a URBG.

methods.name: MixIntoSeedMaterial
methods.description: Mixes a sequence of values into seed material to enhance entropy.

methods.name: GetSaltMaterial
methods.description: Retrieves a salt value, possibly returning an empty optional if unavailable.
